content: The chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage endpoint is an undocumented internal endpoint used by ChatGPT/Codex to expose subscription quota. Response contains rate_limit with two windows: primary_window (~5h, limit_window_seconds=18000) and secondary_window (weekly, limit_window_seconds=604800 = exactly 7 days / 168h). Each window has used_percent (0-100), reset_at (unix epoch seconds), plus hard/soft limit and reset fields. The weekly window resets on its own schedule; a request counts against both windows simultaneously. 401 = expired OAuth token, 403 = endpoint/account not authorized. Token comes from ~/.codex/auth.json tokens.access_token plus optional tokens.account_id sent as ChatGPT-Account-ID header. Third-party tools (codex-quota, tokenuse.app, pi-chatgpt-limit, ai-usage-app) implement the same polling pattern. Caveat: endpoint is internal and field names may change; prefer matching raw fields (used_percent, reset_at) over labels.
